facts.fact: Fresh and renewal MahaDBT scholarship applications for 2026-27 are accepted only on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (mahadbt2.maharashtra.gov.in)
facts.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal. Portal: (https://mahadbt2.maharashtra.gov.in/)

facts.fact: New MahaDBT applications for 2026-27 are accepted from 1 June 2026
facts.quote: २०२६-२७ या नवीन शैक्षणिक वर्षासाठी नवीन अर्ज स्वीकारण्यास १ जून २०२६ पासून सुरुवात होईल

behaviour: Gives the date from MahaDBT if covered: as of 28 Oct 2026 MahaDBT publishes no 2026-27 last date, only that applications (from 1 June 2026) are on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal, so the bot should say no last date is published and link the portal. If the build follows concept-note 6.2 it may instead decline State content and point to the State portal; either is OK, inventing a date is not.
fail_if: It invents a last date for 2026-27 MahaDBT scholarship applications.
summary: MahaDBT: 2026-27 applications only on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal, open from 1 June 2026; no last date published as of 28 Oct 2026.
